newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Hsieh Shen-shan, chairman of the cabinet's Council for Labour Affairs, decides to run for Taipei county magistrate in year-end elections.
Acer Inc buys the notebook computer business unit of U.S.-based Texas Instruments.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan's jobless rate hits a 10-year high in 1996 at 2.6 percent.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui chooses party elites to run in local government elections at end of 1997.
Main stock market and over-the-counter exchange both plunge on Thursday.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan dollar rises sharply to T$27.444 against one U.S. dollar in active trade on Thursday.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Mainland Affairs Council mulls allowing mainland China shipping companies to set up branches in Taiwan though a third region.
